## Language Request

**Which language would you like to add to Mossy?**
<!-- e.g., Arabic (ar), Hindi (hi), Vietnamese (vi) -->

**Language code:**
<!-- ISO 639-1 language code, e.g., ar, hi, vi -->

**Are you willing to help translate?**
<!-- [ ] Yes, I can help translate
     [ ] No, but I would use this language -->

## Translation Issue (if reporting a problem)

**Language affected:**
<!-- e.g., Spanish (es), French (fr) -->

**Location:**
<!-- Which part of the UI? e.g., Settings → Language Settings -->

**Current translation:**
<!-- What text is currently showing? -->

**Suggested correction:**
<!-- What should it say instead? -->

**Additional context:**
<!-- Any other information about the translation issue -->

## For Contributors

If you'd like to help with translations, please see [CONTRIBUTING_TRANSLATIONS.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING_TRANSLATIONS.md) for guidelines.

**Currently supported languages:**
- English (en) - 100%
- Español (es) - ~60%
- Français (fr) - ~60%
- Deutsch (de) - ~60%
- Русский (ru) - ~60%
- 中文（简体）(zh-Hans) - ~60%
- Português (BR) (pt-BR) - ~60%
- 日本語 (ja) - ~60%
- 한국어 (ko) - ~60%
- Italiano (it) - ~60%
- Polski (pl) - ~60%
- Türkçe (tr) - ~60%
